+"""Standalone helper for collecting marks stored on an object, derived class first.
+
+This module intentionally does not depend on pytest so that it stays importable
+without pytest or its mark registry.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from typing import Any
+
+
+__all__ = ["get_derived_first_marks"]
+
+
+def get_derived_first_marks(
+    normalize_mark_list: Callable[[Iterable[Any]], Iterable[Any]],
+    obj: object | type,
+    *,
+    consider_mro: bool = True,
+) -> list[Any]:
+    """Obtain the unpacked marks that are stored on an object.
+
+    If obj is a class and consider_mro is true, return marks applied to
+    this class and all of its super-classes in forward MRO order (the class
+    itself first, ``object`` last). If consider_mro is false, only return
+    marks applied directly to this class.
+
+    :param normalize_mark_list:
+        Callable that turns the collected raw mark list into normalized marks.
+    """
+    if isinstance(obj, type):
+        if not consider_mro:
+            mark_lists = [obj.__dict__.get("pytestmark", [])]
+        else:
+            mark_lists = [x.__dict__.get("pytestmark", []) for x in obj.__mro__]
+        mark_list = []
+        for item in mark_lists:
+            if isinstance(item, list):
+                mark_list.extend(item)
+            else:
+                mark_list.append(item)
+    else:
+        mark_attribute = getattr(obj, "pytestmark", [])
+        if isinstance(mark_attribute, list):
+            mark_list = mark_attribute
+        else:
+            mark_list = [mark_attribute]
+    return list(normalize_mark_list(mark_list))

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,190 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import ModuleType
+from typing import Any
+
+from _pytest.mark.structures import get_unpacked_marks
+from _pytest.mark.structures import Mark
+from _pytest.mark.structures import MarkDecorator
+from _pytest.mark.structures import normalize_mark_list
+import pytest
+
+
+MODULE_PATH = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_derived_first_marks.py"
+
+
+def _load_module() -> ModuleType:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_derived_first_marks", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+get_derived_first_marks = _load_module().get_derived_first_marks
+
+
+def _mark(name: str) -> MarkDecorator:
+    return MarkDecorator(Mark(name, (), {}, _ispytest=True), _ispytest=True)
+
+
+def _identity(marks: Iterable[Any]) -> Iterable[Any]:
+    return marks
+
+
+def _names(marks: Iterable[Any]) -> list[str]:
+    return [m.name for m in marks]
+
+
+@_mark("a")
+class Base:
+    pass
+
+
+@_mark("b")
+class Mid(Base):
+    pass
+
+
+@_mark("c")
+@_mark("d")
+class Leaf(Mid):
+    pass
+
+
+class TestGetDerivedFirstMarks:
+    def test_forward_mro_order(self) -> None:
+        marks = get_derived_first_marks(normalize_mark_list, Leaf)
+        assert _names(marks) == ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
+
+    def test_is_reverse_of_reference_by_class(self) -> None:
+        assert _names(get_derived_first_marks(normalize_mark_list, Leaf)) == [
+            "d",
+            "c",
+            "b",
+            "a",
+        ]
+        assert _names(get_unpacked_marks(Leaf)) == ["a", "b", "d", "c"]
+
+    def test_direct_only_matches_reference(self) -> None:
+        marks = get_derived_first_marks(normalize_mark_list, Leaf, consider_mro=False)
+        assert marks == get_unpacked_marks(Leaf, consider_mro=False)
+        assert _names(marks) == ["d", "c"]
+
+    def test_multiple_inheritance(self) -> None:
+        @_mark("x")
+        class X:
+            pass
+
+        @_mark("y")
+        class Y:
+            pass
+
+        @_mark("z")
+        class Z(X, Y):
+            pass
+
+        assert _names(get_derived_first_marks(normalize_mark_list, Z)) == [
+            "z",
+            "x",
+            "y",
+        ]
+
+    def test_scalar_class_attribute(self) -> None:
+        class Scalar:
+            pytestmark: Any = _mark("s")
+
+        class Child(Scalar):
+            pytestmark = [_mark("t"), _mark("u")]
+
+        assert _names(get_derived_first_marks(normalize_mark_list, Child)) == [
+            "t",
+            "u",
+            "s",
+        ]
+
+    def test_class_without_marks(self) -> None:
+        class Plain:
+            pass
+
+        assert get_derived_first_marks(normalize_mark_list, Plain) == []
+        assert (
+            get_derived_first_marks(normalize_mark_list, Plain, consider_mro=False)
+            == []
+        )
+
+    def test_instance_uses_getattr(self) -> None:
+        instance = Leaf()
+        marks = get_derived_first_marks(normalize_mark_list, instance)
+        assert marks == get_unpacked_marks(instance)
+        assert _names(marks) == ["d", "c"]
+
+    def test_instance_consider_mro_ignored(self) -> None:
+        def func() -> None:
+            pass
+
+        func.pytestmark = [_mark("f").mark]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        for consider_mro in (True, False):
+            assert get_derived_first_marks(
+                normalize_mark_list, func, consider_mro=consider_mro
+            ) == get_unpacked_marks(func, consider_mro=consider_mro)
+
+    def test_instance_scalar_attribute(self) -> None:
+        def func() -> None:
+            pass
+
+        func.pytestmark = _mark("g")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        assert _names(get_derived_first_marks(normalize_mark_list, func)) == ["g"]
+
+    def test_instance_without_marks(self) -> None:
+        assert get_derived_first_marks(normalize_mark_list, object()) == []
+
+    def test_returns_new_list(self) -> None:
+        def func() -> None:
+            pass
+
+        stored = ["m1", "m2"]
+        func.pytestmark = stored  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        result = get_derived_first_marks(_identity, func)
+        assert result == stored
+        assert result is not stored
+
+    def test_normalizer_receives_raw_list(self) -> None:
+        received: list[list[Any]] = []
+
+        def normalizer(marks: Iterable[Any]) -> Iterable[Any]:
+            received.append(list(marks))
+            return ["normalized"]
+
+        assert get_derived_first_marks(normalizer, Leaf) == ["normalized"]
+        assert len(received) == 1
+        assert _names(received[0]) == ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
+
+    def test_normalizer_errors_propagate(self) -> None:
+        class Bad:
+            pytestmark = ["not a mark"]
+
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="got 'not a mark' instead of Mark"):
+            get_derived_first_marks(normalize_mark_list, Bad)
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="got 'not a mark' instead of Mark"):
+            get_unpacked_marks(Bad)
+
+
+def test_module_does_not_import_pytest() -> None:
+    tree = ast.parse(MODULE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imported: set[str] = set()
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+            imported.update(alias.name for alias in node.names)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module is not None:
+            imported.add(node.module)
+    assert imported
+    assert not {
+        name for name in imported if name.split(".")[0] in {"pytest", "_pytest"}
+    }
notes:
Copied get_unpacked_marks' control flow into a pytest-free module that takes the normalizer as a parameter and walks obj.__mro__ forward instead of reversed; class/instance paths, direct-only mode, list/scalar handling and final list(normalize(...)) are unchanged. Tests load the module by file path and compare against get_unpacked_marks, plus an AST check that it imports no pytest module.
